zh-TW.title: 顏色與字形
zh-TW.description: 判斷散布的字母中有沒有中央圓圈裡的綠色目標字，其他字與目標同色或同形。十二級視覺搜尋的第 9 到 12 級。

en.title: Visual Search: Conjunction
en.description: Decide whether the green letter shown in the centre circle is among the scattered letters. The others share its colour or its shape. Levels 9 to 12 of 12.
